milestones.description: Uses inventory_has for 'bowl' because eating mushroom_stew consumes the stew and returns an empty bowl to inventory. The player starts with no bowl in this scene (only tools are given), so having a bowl proves consumption occurred. Independent task completable anytime.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch logs with the provided wooden axe drops birch_log items into inventory. The sealed birch enclosure (x=3-7, z=1-3) provides ample logs. Player needs at least 1 to prove they breached the enclosure wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The rabbit is in a fully-fenced pen at spawn-relative [10,0,2], only accessible after mining through the birch enclosure's east wall (x=7). max_distance=4 ensures the player must be very close to the pen (from spawn at origin, distance to [10,0,2] is ~10.2 blocks, so player must move significantly). facing_tolerance=60 ensures player is looking toward the rabbit.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch door drops it as a birch_door item into inventory. The door is sealed inside the birch log chamber at (5,0-1,2), only accessible after mining through the enclosure walls. Player starts with no birch_door.

Uses position_inside_box because this is a traversal/movement task. The player must cross the 9-block-wide, 3-5 block deep water channel (z=5-13) and arrive on the far shore (z>=14). The wide deep water makes the boat at the dock the natural/obvious crossing method. Box covers the entire far-side area beyond the water.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The pink stained glass pane is placed at spawn-relative [8,0,15] on the far-side platform. max_distance=5 requires close proximity (player must have crossed water first since z=15 is past the channel). facing_tolerance=60 ensures visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The purple stained glass pane is at spawn-relative [10,0,15]. Player must be within 5 blocks and facing it to demonstrate they located and identified it on the far-side platform.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The green stained glass pane is at spawn-relative [12,0,15]. Player must be within 5 blocks and facing it to confirm visual identification on the far-side platform.

Uses inventory_has because the player has a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe, which causes white stained glass to drop as an item when mined (without Silk Touch, glass yields nothing). The blocks are at (8-10, 0, 17) on the far side. Player starts with no white_stained_glass in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because orange concrete powder always drops itself as an item when mined with any tool or by hand (no special enchantment needed). The blocks are at (13-14, 0, 17) on the far side of the water channel. Player starts with none in inventory.

Uses two count_in_box_at_least rules to verify meaningful house construction on the cobblestone foundation (x=14-19, z=19-23). First rule checks birch_door placement (entrance/structural element), second checks white_stained_glass placement (windows). Together these prove the player gathered materials from both the enclosure (door) and far side (glass) and placed them as a structure. Box is generous (±3 around foundation) to allow creative placement.
